about: Lines of real Frontiers rings placed on BeamNG's ground (Lua raycasts) ahead of Sonic, following his run. Each row becomes one SpawnRow; the test row is used only while Melty's test file exists.

columns.mode: play = normal play, test = Melty test runs
columns.minKmh: speed needed before a line appears
columns.startMeters: distance ahead of Sonic of the first ring
